name: shards
source:
You wake up in a mysterious place and must answer questions to leave. In the process, maybe you'll learn something about yourself. Maybe you'll see tomorrow. Look at the shards, and maybe you'll see the stars.

[From [url=https://luoxyz.itch.io/shards]Itch.io[/url]]
